result:
The retry problem was that every save attempt called the identifier generator again, so a retry of a partly completed save could take another identifier from the source. The fix is a per-submission `SavePatientTransactionManager` that remembers generated values and completed identifier additions, so a retry reuses them. I could not identify the commit or ticket that made this change: my tools don't expose commit history, and the code has no ticket reference for it. The only ticket key in the registration app is `O3-5912`, on an unrelated address-hierarchy test.

The registration app lives in `openmrs-esm-patient-management` (there is no `openmrs-esm-patient-registration` repo in Falkon).

**Why more than one identifier was used:** Before this change, each attempt at `savePatientFormOnline` called `generateIdentifier(selectedSource.uuid)` for every auto-generated identifier. A retry after a partial failure (the patient save or an identifier addition failed after generation) therefore requested a fresh value, and the earlier value was never used.

**The fix, as the code now reads:**
- `form-manager.ts` (lines 217–235): before generating, it checks `generatedIdentifiers[fieldName]`. If an earlier attempt generated a value from the same source, that value is reused. Otherwise it generates one and stores it.
- `form-manager.ts` (lines 250–265): for an existing patient, an identifier addition that already succeeded is skipped on retry (`addedIdentifiers`). A failed addition is retried with the same value.
- `form-manager.ts` (lines 425–440): the `GeneratedIdentifier` type and the `SavePatientTransactionManager` class holding `patientSaved`, `generatedIdentifiers` and `addedIdentifiers`. Its doc comment says it exists so a retry only repeats the work that failed.
- `patient-registration.component.tsx` (line 63): the manager is held in a `useRef`, so it survives retries within one form session.
- `patient-registration.test.tsx` (lines 681–714): retry state is kept for the same patient and reset when the route patient changes.

**Tests that pin the behaviour** (`form-manager.test.ts`, lines 673–787): a new-patient retry reuses `10001V`; an existing-patient retry does not repeat a successful addition; a failed addition is retried with the same value; a changed source generates a new value.

Nothing in the repository was modified.
